_comment: Unlike a hook-based capability, gsd-messaging registers NO Claude Code settings.json hook - escalation and the doorbell fire inside GSD workflow turns, not host lifecycle events. There is nothing to hand-register here. This snippet instead shows the GSD config toggles (all default-off) that `gsd capability install messaging` sets for you; merge into your GSD federated config (.planning/config.json or ~/.gsd/defaults.json) only if you are enabling manually.
